description: This time our theme is **Love & Dating Across Cultures** — first dates, awkward moments, dating apps, and how relationships begin in different parts of the world. We’ll explore how cultural expectations shape dating, what people consider romantic (or embarrassing), and how modern technology has changed the way people meet. From funny misunderstandings to surprising cultural traditions, this theme offers plenty of room for humor, curiosity, and cultural comparison. It’s a great opportunity to exchange stories, reflect on different social norms, and practice speaking about relationships and social life in your target language. Our languages: English, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, and German. At Speak & Sip, we do things a little differently. There’s structure — but the atmosphere is still relaxed. Think of it as semi-serious, semi-casual: fun and social, but with the clear purpose of improving our language skills. Here’s how it works: • **Each language has its own table** with a host or fluent speakers to guide the group. • **Native speakers** are always welcome to join their table and support learners. • For the **first hour**, we use conversation cards on the theme to keep things flowing. You’ll switch partners regularly so you can practice with different people. • The **second hour** is dedicated to games related to the theme — light, interactive, and designed to make everyone speak more. If you want something lighter, there will also be an **English chill table** where people can sit together and talk about any topic. But if your goal is to practice languages in a structured way, this is the right meetup for you.
